css-at-font-face: Known debt: Lexend web font from Google Fonts in layout.mjml; clients without support fall back to sans-serif. Remove with the system font stack.
css-at-import: Known debt: MJML mj-font emits @import for Google Fonts; remove with the system font stack.
css-at-media: MJML responsive columns and the prefers-color-scheme dark overrides are progressive enhancement; clients without @media render the fluid mobile-first layout.
css-background: MJML shorthand for section backgrounds; the matching background-color and bgcolor attributes carry the colour where shorthand is unsupported.
css-background-color: Card and body colours; MJML also emits bgcolor attributes for clients that strip inline background-color.
css-border: Dividers and table rules are decorative; content stays readable without them.
css-border-radius: Rounded corners on buttons and cards degrade to square corners.
css-direction: MJML emits direction:ltr on columns; unsupported clients use the document direction.
css-display: MJML hides the mobile/desktop helpers and preheader with display; the fallback shows harmless duplicate spacing only.
css-font-weight: Emphasis only; unsupported clients render normal weight.
css-height: Spacer and sparkline heights set by MJML; Outlook uses the accompanying height attributes.
css-letter-spacing: Uppercase table header tracking in site_report and analytics_digest is cosmetic.
css-line-height: Typography rhythm; unsupported clients use their default line height.
css-margin: MJML resets margins on generated elements; spacing is carried by padding cells.
css-max-width: Centres the 600px container; Outlook uses the MJML ghost table with a fixed width.
css-padding: Core MJML layout spacing; clients with partial support (Outlook on paragraphs) are covered by MJML's table-cell padding.
css-table-layout: Fixed table layout keeps metric columns aligned; auto layout remains readable.
css-text-align: Alignment of headers and numbers; the align attribute is emitted as a fallback.
css-text-decoration: Removes link underlines for styled links; underlined links remain usable.
css-text-transform: Uppercase table headers are cosmetic; source text is already a readable label.
css-unit-rem: Known debt: site_report.mjml uses 2.5rem for the headline figure; convert to px in the email design pass.
css-width: MJML column widths with width attributes as the fallback for Outlook.
css-word-break: Lets long URLs and domains wrap in tables; without it the cell grows but stays readable.
html-body: Standard <body> element; flagged only because some webmail clients replace it with their own wrapper.
html-link: Known debt: <link> to Google Fonts from mj-font; remove with the system font stack.
html-style: MJML inlines styles; the <style> block only carries responsive and dark-mode enhancements.
